design_note: Uses three atomic facts (age 66, starting daily cholesterol medicine 3 weeks ago, and sudden tearing back pain between the shoulder blades today) with a 10-word vs 12-word continuous span swap in first person. Swapping only symptom quality and severity in atomic fact f3 from 'got a sudden tearing misery' to 'got mild muscle soreness' at the exact same upper-back site keeps every surrounding fact coherent (new mild muscle soreness 3 weeks after starting daily cholesterol medicine warrants outpatient physician medication review, level 2, obeying reviewer_notes.md Rule A) with identical digits and zero stated negatives.
